allow: PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conns\) { $conns | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "PID $\($_.OwningProcess\) = $\($p.ProcessName\)"; Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } else { "nothing on 3000" }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; "done")
